description.value: Cowichan River Lodge is a boutique private lodge perched on the banks of the Cowichan River, one of Canada's first Heritage-designated rivers and among North America's top-rated trout rivers. The property is rented exclusively as a full lodge for groups, making it suited to cycling clubs, family gatherings, or corporate retreats rather than individual walk-in guests. Host John helps guests connect with local outdoor pursuits including fishing, mountain biking, and wider exploration of the Cowichan Valley.
